CPV.note: Reports an attack on parliament's network and an investigation with NOSi and Polícia Judiciária; no national cyber body or alert is stated.

facts.fact: Lusa reports that the Assembleia Nacional's communication and security department head says its technicians isolated the infected network segment and are building a parallel infrastructure while cleaning and recovering machines.

CPV.note: Polícia Judiciária named only as co-investigator of an attack; nothing on station records.
